human_check_steps:
# Check: sign in with the code (ticker.allomos.com)

1. On an iPhone, add ticker.allomos.com to the home screen (Share › Add to Home Screen) and open it from there. Ask for a sign-in link.
2. In Mail, the email shows a large code (like K7QM-4XRP-9TWD-2HNC). Long-press it: the whole code is selected; copy it.
3. Back in the home-screen app (it may have reloaded): the "Check your email" screen still shows the code field. Tap Paste (or paste by hand), then "Sign in with code": you are signed in.
4. Open the same email's link in Safari: it now says the link does not work (the code used it up).
5. Ask for another link and open it in a browser: the page shows the code with a Copy button; tap Copy and paste somewhere to see it copied. Then "Sign in" signs that browser in.
6. Type a wrong code five times: the request is voided and the right code no longer works.
